policy.research_lane: May contain datasets/models permitted for evaluation or research only. Never export these examples into production weights without a separate rights review.
policy.production_lane: Every source must have rights_reviewed=true, commercial_training_allowed=true, and derivative_models_allowed=true before production training.

datasets.name: EDM-CUE
datasets.license: review source release before production use
datasets.notes: Metadata/annotations only. DJAI does not redistribute or automatically acquire copyrighted source audio. CUE-DETR remains an optional research cue prior.

datasets.name: DJAI Expert Demonstrations on Cleared Audio
datasets.notes: Only records whose source_rights_confirmed flag is true may enter the production lane.

datasets.name: DJAI Synthetic Technical Failure Corpus
datasets.source: Generated from rights-cleared DJAI source renders
datasets.license: inherits cleared source rights; generated labels owned by project
datasets.notes: Generation must only use source audio that is cleared for the intended training use.

datasets.name: UnmixDB
datasets.license: source record describes Creative-Commons-licensed redistributable electronic dance tracks; exact production reuse review pending
datasets.notes: External data remains research-only until SAUND.AI completes a source-specific production rights review.

datasets.name: Free Music Archive (FMA)
datasets.license: metadata CC BY 4.0; audio uses per-track artist-selected licenses
datasets.notes: Importer preserves per-track license metadata. The full audio dataset is never treated as globally production-cleared.

datasets.name: ListenBrainz public listens
datasets.license: public user listen data published CC0; privacy/product review pending
datasets.notes: Normalizer hashes user identifiers and does not store raw usernames.

datasets.name: Medley2K
datasets.license: review dataset release terms before production use
datasets.notes: Human-curated medley transitions are structural evidence, not direct proof of professional DJ preference.
